name: Barber's Ruckytucks PYO Farm
description: Barber's Ruckytucks PYO Farm is an agritourism farm in 206 Ruckytucks Rd, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
